title: Slice (fiber-integration) forms over [0, 1], affine end slices, the slice homotopy identities, and the Minkowski bound for the coefficient norm
statement: For all N, k ∈ ℕ, writing ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), Jv := ι(0, v), e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1), |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α and d := exteriorDerivative (Mathlib extDeriv): (a) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) (TestFormOn univ (k + 1)) there is η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ∫_0^1 ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x and v, and tsupport η ⊆ {x : ∃ t ∈ [0, 1], ι(t, x) ∈ tsupport ω}; (b) for every s ∈ ℝ and ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N+1}) there is ρ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with ρ(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all x and v; (c) for every β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and θ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) such that θ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 β(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) dt for all x and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, one has, for all x and v = (v_0, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}, ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_0, …, Jv_k) dt = β(ι(1, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) − β(ι(0, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) − dθ(x)(v); (d) for every β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}), x ∈ ℝ^N and the empty tuple v: ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀) dt = β(ι(1, x))() − β(ι(0, x))(); (e) for every k-covector α on ℝ^N, continuous f : ℝ → Λ^k(ℝ^N)* and c ∈ ℝ with α(v) = ∫_0^1 f(t)(v) dt for all v and |f(t)| ≤ c for all t ∈ [0, 1]: |α| ≤ c.
